scope: Addressed/unpaired AF_UNIX read/write, readv/writev, sendto/recvfrom and sendmsg/recvmsg on workers, actual packet metadata/portable rights, canonical target waits and original-owner fallback.
method: Four independent processes, each 1,000 checked iterations, four Trames vCPUs and three unprofiled counterbalanced before/after samples. All compilation, local Linux CI and FFI acceptance finish before final timing. Identical static ARM64 musl ELF for Trames/native Linux, with native Linux collected on the existing six-vCPU environment and stopped before Mac timings. Native macOS uses native APIs. One-byte datagram data is checked on every iteration; sendto/recvfrom also checks the exact source pathname. Endpoint creation/bind/connect/unlink is outside the datagram timer; the portable-rights case creates its pipe outside the loop and times sendmsg/recvmsg, alias EOF read and alias close. The separate owner-device case includes /dev/null open/send/close/recv/alias read/close and intentionally retains the existing owner boundary. Socketpair lifecycle is the unchanged-path regression. Longest-child loop medians and whole-process wall medians include different work and are reported separately. Kernel/API/compiler/CPU-count differences make native values contextual; these are not application, Firefox, iPad or generally native-speed claims.

resource_regressions: 64 packets from eight concurrent senders keep exact packet/source/credential association without owner ledger entries
portable rights, timestamps and late-enabled passcred preserve metadata in the actual queue
native Core/LocalSocket/DirectFd default-connected sends reach the same target queue
target capacity notification, final receiver close and pathname rebind never redirect a retained call
sender FD reuse preserves original full OFD and frozen payload/address
raw/vector/message receive and legacy-rights handoff retain original output metadata and owner authority
subscribe/retry on the original owner closes the unlock-before-park gap
validation.unchanged_acceptance: Source-unchanged passes reused after documentation, runtime pin and benchmark-fixture updates. Unrelated CPU/memory/graphics acceptance and guest artifacts reused.

implementation.queue: Source address, credentials and portable shared OFDs travel in actual packet queues. Ordinary datagrams need no owner ancillary ID; Unix-bearing owning graphs retain the original owner ledger/cycle checks.
implementation.target: One accepted target: original source full OFD, weak destination endpoint and original queue/readiness. No FD/path relookup after EAGAIN or owner handoff; target-space and source notifications, plus actual target scheduling relation.
implementation.abi: Original decoder/transport rules, frozen input bytes and vector/address records, original output-range preflight before dequeue; one seccomp decision per accepted filtered entry.
implementation.waits: Worker and owner subscribe/retry return execution slots. Source/name/peer guards do not span readiness callbacks or final OFD drops. No new global lock, resource thread, bus, polling, ordinary-memory fence or native-only permission layer.

discovered_assumptions.observed: Existing supports_fd admitted only control/message calls for every nonstream Unix socket, so newly implemented retained datagram byte I/O still joined the owner.
discovered_assumptions.fix: Admit addressed/unpaired datagram byte and packet calls, including the dedicated filtered entry; prove zero services and one decision per entry in one/two-slot tests.

discovered_assumptions.observed: Pure unpaired datagrams previously stored source/credentials in the owner ancillary ledger, forcing unnecessary owner bookkeeping.
discovered_assumptions.fix: Move per-packet metadata into the actual shared queue, retain ledger entries only for legacy owning rights.

discovered_assumptions.observed: An initial rights benchmark used /dev/null, whose opens/rights still cross an owner boundary, and showed no material gain.
discovered_assumptions.fix: Keep that explicit unchanged-boundary workload and add a separate portable pipe-rights benchmark; final measurements cover both without treating device rights as migrated.

discovered_assumptions.observed: Owner retry subscribed only after EAGAIN without a second original-resource check.
discovered_assumptions.fix: Subscribe then retry before parking, using the same accepted records and full OFD.

remaining: Unix-bearing ancillary owning graphs and cycle reclamation
Owner-only device opens/rights and native-service adapters
io_uring controls, mount/nsfs topology and proc controls
Pending task signals and structural file/VM/task transitions; residual whole-process cohort joins
